findings.text: the log's first line reads "declared mutation: make the truncation question always answer that the repository is complete" while the run's declared negative_control reads "make the shallow-history question always answer that the repository is complete, so the probe returns never-tracked for a truncated history again: the depth-1 clone case in tests/test_a_promotion_never_creates_a_ledger.py must go red"; the declaration is not a substring of the log (measured: False, and no line of the log carries it), so the promotion's check at reckon/crew/promotion.py:3270 refuses the run unless the declaration is corrected to the mutation the log shows or the mismatch is waived, while docs/plans/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion.html:2505 and the anchor at docs/evidence/archive/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion-landed.html:926 both claim the log's first line repeats the declaration verbatim.

the recorded ruff comparison is stated as "13 at base c16659ff excluding I001 (15 raw; the two extra are import-sorting findings on a block a later commit already sorted)" and the raw figure does not reproduce: under the locked ruff 0.16.4 over reckon/ledger.py with that revision's own declared rule set I measure 13 findings and zero I001 hits, and --select I001 alone reports none, while the same instrument reports 55 I001 findings elsewhere in that revision - so the instrument sees the rule; the load-bearing half of the claim still holds (head 13 with zero SIM102 against the node's own diff base 45ecc873's 14 with one SIM102), so only this supporting figure is unreproducible and it propagates to the plan landing record and the manifest.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit - 529f9d9f is the probe and the collapsed call site (65/12 in reckon/ledger.py plus 129/35 of tests), e4f67a21 adds the grafted and partial-clone tests, 94ea2abc is documentation only (anchor, plan record, figure); nothing changed outside the declared paths and no source path moved in the docs commit.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks for a real depth-1 clone refusal, the full-never-tracked clone still creating, the pinned GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES case, the SIM102 removal and a green named pair with both counts; I reproduced all of them in scratch archives of the node's own revisions - 22 passed exit 0 at e4f67a21 (10 + 12) against 17 passed exit 0 at base 45ecc873 (5 + 12), the declared mutation reddening exactly the four truncation cases at 4 failed / 6 passed with DID NOT RAISE LedgerError on the depth-1 case, and 13 findings with zero SIM102 at head against 14 with one SIM102 at the node's own diff base - but two supporting figures the record states do not reproduce, and the negative-control log does not name the declared mutation.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the tracked-ness probe answers unknown rather than never-tracked wherever the checkout cannot answer, so a shallow, grafted or partial history stops reading as a project that never had a ledger; reckon/ledger.py:1739 adds _history_is_truncated covering a shallow repository (rev-parse --is-shallow-repository), a refs/replace ref, an info/grafts file and a promisor remote, and reckon/ledger.py:1806 returns None from _ledger_ever_tracked where it holds, which the call site at reckon/ledger.py:1855 already refuses on via `is not False`; I reproduced the incident outcome on the unfixed module and the refusal after it, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the three commits, the five declared paths, the gate at both ends with log paths, the negative control with its first-line reading, and a checkpoint naming the tree state, and its figures reproduce under my own instrument except the two named below; the one record-shape defect is that its tests field states PYTHONPATH as the worktree while gate-after.log records PYTHONPATH as the shared checkout, with a provenance note proving the worktree module is what ran (tests/__init__.py exists, so pytest prepends the worktree root), so the measurement stands but the manifest's stated command and the log's differ.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read against git diff --numstat 45ecc873..529f9d9f (65/12 reckon/ledger.py, 129/35 tests/test_a_promotion_never_creates_a_ledger.py), e4f67a21..94ea2abc (73/0 evidence anchor, 3/0 plan record, one binary figure) and the 200/31 total over the two commits - exactly the five declared paths and nothing else, with the worktree clean at 94ea2abc.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_promotion_never_creates_a_ledger.py:188-275 asserts each truncation branch against a real mechanism with the fixture asserting git's own answer first, the declared mutation reddens exactly four of the ten cases (DID NOT RAISE), no assertion compares a value against the same variable the test passed in, and the deduction is that the `extensions.partialClone` spelling and _git_stdout's failing-query return are exercised by no test.
justifications.evidence: the gate reproduces exactly under my own instrument (22/17 green, delta +5 passed and 0 new failures) and the declared mutation reddens exactly the four truncation cases, but the log at the named path does not contain the run's declared mutation - so promotion's check at reckon/crew/promotion.py:3270 refuses it - and the ruff figure recorded at docs/evidence/archive/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion-landed.html:930 (15 raw, two I001) does not reproduce: 13 findings and zero I001 hits measured under the locked ruff 0.16.4.
justifications.fit: _git_stdout and _history_is_truncated at reckon/ledger.py:1728-1771 follow the module's subprocess-with-check=False idiom and its mechanism-naming style, the collapse of the nested conditional is the SIM102 remedy the done-when names, and no plan, stage or ticket identifier appears in any symbol, comment or test name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1739-1771 detects all four truncation forms and reckon/ledger.py:1806 withdraws the answer, reached in production only through the promotion call site at reckon/crew/promotion.py:3632, which refuses through the pre-existing `is not False` - and I reproduced both the pre-repair incident (unfixed module returns version 1 and creates the ledger) and the post-repair refusal independently.
justifications.scope_discipline: numstat over both commits lists exactly the five declared paths (reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_a_promotion_never_creates_a_ledger.py, the evidence anchor, the figure directory, the plan), insertions-only on the documentation side, and the worktree is clean at 94ea2abc with no other path written.
